kashika: भस्येत्ययमधिकारः, आ अध्यायपरिसमाप्तेः। यदित ऊर्ध्वमनुक्रमिष्यामो भस्येत्येवं तद् वेदितव्यम्। वक्ष्यति — <<पादःपत्>> [[६.४.१३०]] — द्विपदः पश्य। द्विपदा कृतम्। भस्येति किम्? द्विपादौ, द्विपादः॥
kashikaEnglish: Adhikāra: Following rules apply to भ-designated stems (weak cases).
englishShort: All the rules starting from this sutra, till the end of the sixth chapter are being told for a भसंज्ञक.
englishFull:
भस्य — ADHIKĀRA: "Of भ" — the remaining rules in this adhyāya apply to भ-designated stems.

भ is assigned to stems before case endings other than सर्वनामस्थान (@ref[1.4.18]).
